# Synopsys golden files

**Redistribution check required before the repo goes public.** Any report generated by a real
DC / VCS run that is added here is Synopsys tool output; see "Needs owner" in `PROGRESS.md`.

## `samples/` — hand-written format samples, NOT tool output

The files in `samples/` were written by hand to reproduce the text layout of Design Compiler
reports (`report_timing`, `report_qor`, `report_area -hierarchy`, `report_constraints
-all_violators`, `report_power`, `report_reference -hierarchy`, `report_resources`,
`report_design`, `report_units`), a combined `.rep` file and a DC log. Designs, cell names,
library names and numbers are invented (generic `*_RVT` / `*_T75_R` style names, no library
content). File paths inside them are placeholders (`/path/to/libs/...`).

**Replace / extend them with real DC outputs from CAEN runs** (`pytest -m synopsys` writes
real reports under `.svkit/runs/`), then regenerate the expected JSON and review the diff.

| Sample | Exercises |
|---|---|
| `timing_ns_met.rpt` | `-input_pins -nets -transition -capacitance` columns, annotations `*` `&`, net rows, hierarchical pins, input port path, ns library |
| `timing_ps_violated.rpt` | ps library (no unit hint: magnitude heuristic), violated path, output port endpoint, wrapped long names (both wrap styles) |
| `timing_hold.rpt` | `-delay min` paths, `library hold time`, hold violation |
| `qor_ns.rpt` | several path groups, hold violation, cell count / area / design rules sections |
| `area_hier.rpt` | area summary with `undefined`-free totals, nested hierarchical area table with a wrapped row |
| `constraints_violators.rpt` / `constraints_clean.rpt` | setup / hold / max_transition / max_fanout violators, wrapped endpoint; clean design |
| `power_uw.rpt` | uW / nW summary, power-group table with per-column units |
| `reference_hier.rpt` | `report_reference -hierarchy` with nested designs instantiated twice (flattened counts) |
| `resources.rpt` | resource-sharing and implementation tables with continuation rows |
| `design.rpt` | operating conditions (corner), wire-load model, libraries |
| `combined_ns.rep` | a combined report in the order `report_design`, `report_timing -max_paths 2`, `report_constraints -all_violators`, `report_power`, `report_resources -hier`, `report_area -hierarchy`, `report_reference -hierarchy` |
| `combined_ps.rep` | `report_units` (ps), qor, timing, area, reference, power with mW / pW |
| `dc_warnings.log` | warnings/errors with codes, multi-line messages, duplicates, removed registers (OPT-1206/1207/1215) |
| `*.files` | multi-file samples: the listed files are parsed together as one run |

Each sample `X.ext` (or `X.files`) has `X.expected.json`: the normalized `SynthResult`
(`svkit.schemas`) produced by `svkit.adapters.synth.dc.DcAdapter.parse`. Standalone samples use the
parser's default time unit (ns) unless the text states a unit or the clock period is >= 100 units.

Regenerate after an intentional parser change, then review `git diff`:

```
SVKIT_REGEN_GOLDEN=1 python -m pytest tests/test_dc_reports.py -q
```
